# RhetorLint Claim Feedback

Canonical source: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/rhetorlint-spec/tree/main/examples/claim-feedback
Correction route: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/rhetorlint-spec/issues/new
Correction visibility: public, optional, and external to this Cloudflare door
Correction warning: do not submit private claim files or personal, sensitive,
confidential, or third-party material to the public issue tracker
Licence: MIT, as declared by the source repository

This Cloudflare origin serves reviewed static documentation, two closed JSON
schemas, one fictional example using reserved example.org URLs, a bounded
browser-memory worksheet, a machine-readable manifest, and exact release
hashes. The browser and Node adapters use the same deterministic packet
projection.

The worksheet has no submission endpoint, Worker or Pages Function,
server-side claim processor, crawler, fetcher, storage binding, analytics code,
model call, KARMA signer, dataset writer, timer, or background loop. It runs
only after a person supplies one bounded record and chooses Run. Stop and Clear
invalidate pending work. Cloudflare still receives the ordinary page and
static-asset requests. The app does not send the supplied claim bytes.

RhetorLint marks visible wording patterns. It does not decide truth, lies,
intent, ego, motive, character, trust, or person worth. The supplied crawl
receipt is not authenticated. Robots access is not copyright, privacy, reuse,
or AI-training permission. Public availability does not prove dataset
selection, training, model update, removal, or correction uptake. Training
output remains held for independent review with candidate null. KARMA output
remains an unsigned, non-importable draft.

Machine doors:
- /.well-known/claim-feedback.json
- /contracts/claim-feedback-input.schema.json
- /contracts/claim-feedback-packet.schema.json
- /examples/corrected-claim.json
- /release-lock.json
